original_question: Suppose we are given an S3 -bundle S3 → E → − M over a 4-manifold M with nontrivial Euler class and p1 . Mather-Thurston’s theory says we can find a bordism of this bundle to a C 0 -flat bundle S3 → E ′ → M ′ . Can one bound the simplicial volume of M ′ so that it does not depend on the bundle map p?
target_in_paper: Section 3.4, Question 3.13. correct_elements: Your draft already captures essentially all of the paper’s intended content: the fiber is S^3, the base is a 4-manifold, the hypotheses are nontrivial Euler class and first Pontryagin class, Mather–Thurston theory is used to pass by bordism to a C^0-flat S^3-bundle, and the question is whether the simplicial volume of the new base M' can be bounded independently of the original bundle map p. ([conferences.cirm-math.fr](https://conferences.cirm-math.fr/wp-content/uploads/2025/03/Problem_list_3082.pdf))
missing_details: The official target is an open problem labeled Question 3.13 in Section 3.4, and the paper presents it only as a heuristic or 'roughly speaking' formulation of a hoped-for controlled version of Mather–Thurston theory, not as a formal conjecture. ([conferences.cirm-math.fr](https://conferences.cirm-math.fr/wp-content/uploads/2025/03/Problem_list_3082.pdf))
To make the question fully stand-alone, the bundle maps should be named explicitly as p:E→M and p':E'→M'.

The phrase 'nontrivial Euler class and p1' should be unpacked as referring to the characteristic classes e(p) and p1(p) of the given S^3-bundle (equivalently, of the associated oriented rank-4 real vector bundle), naturally lying in H^4(M;Z).
The quantity to be bounded should be written explicitly as the simplicial volume ||M'|| of the replacement base M'.

The hidden quantifier should be made explicit: the question is whether one can obtain a C^0-flat replacement via Mather–Thurston bordism with a uniform bound on ||M'|| that does not depend on the original bundle map p.
refined_question: Let p:E→M be an S^3-bundle over a 4-manifold M whose Euler class e(p) and first Pontryagin class p1(p) are both nontrivial. Mather–Thurston theory for C^0-foliations implies that p is bordant to a C^0-flat S^3-bundle p':E'→M'. Can one choose such a bordism so that the simplicial volume ||M'|| of the base M' is bounded above by a constant independent of the original bundle map p?
justification: The draft is essentially a near-verbatim paraphrase of Question 3.13. The surrounding paragraph explains the intended scope: Theorem 3.10 states that for flat S^3-bundles the Euler class and first Pontryagin class are unbounded; Question 3.12 records Freedman’s related question for generalized Hopf fibrations; and the paragraph immediately before Question 3.13 recalls that Mather–Thurston theory for C^0-foliations makes any S^3-bundle bordant to a flat C^0 S^3-bundle. Question 3.13 then asks exactly whether one can bound the simplicial volume of the replacement base M' independently of p. ([conferences.cirm-math.fr](https://conferences.cirm-math.fr/wp-content/uploads/2025/03/Problem_list_3082.pdf))
